title: Your team's context. Finally in one place.
metaTitle: Your team's context. Finally in one place. - Mochi
description: Product Updates: Team Chat puts your team's notes, updates, and context directly on the lead. One thread. One source of truth. No more scattered conversations.
label: Product Updates

blocks.name: Content 1
blocks.html:
Team Chat is here. And it's going to change how your team works together.

No more Slack threads you can't find. No more WhatsApp messages asking "who's this lead again?" No more scrambling before calls trying to piece together context from four different places.

Team Chat lives directly on the lead. Every note. Every update. Every piece of context—one thread, one source of truth.

blocks.name: Content 2
blocks.html:
How it works

1. One place for everything

Open any lead and you'll see a new Team tab in the right panel. That's where your team's conversation lives. Tag a teammate, leave a note, share an update. Everyone on your team sees the full picture on every lead.



2. @mention to notify

Need someone's attention? Just @mention them. They'll see it in their Priority inbox immediately. No more "did you see my message?" No more context lost in a sea of notifications.

blocks.name: Content 3
blocks.html:
Your team's space

This isn't a replacement for how you talk to your leads. It's a space just for your team—setters, closers, managers—to coordinate without the noise.

Think of it as the conversation that happens around the lead, not with them.

Team Chat is available now for all Mochi users. Open any lead, click the Team tab, and start collaborating.
